A collection of two vintage 12-inch vinyl records featuring classic orchestral and musical theater recordings. These albums offer a glimpse into mid-century audio production and are suitable for collectors of vintage vinyl.
Rodgers & Hammerstein's Pipe Dream, Original Cast Recording, RCA Victor LOC-1023.
Andre Kostelanetz and His Orchestra, You and the Night and the Music, Columbia CL 772.
Both records are 33 1/3 RPM long play albums.
Includes original cardboard sleeves with track listings and liner notes.
Condition:
These are pre-owned vintage records. The sleeves show signs of age, including edge wear, corner rubbing, and some surface discoloration. Please see photos for details.

Description
: Discover this captivating collection of raw mineral and crystal specimens, perfect for collectors, hobbyists, or those interested in geology and natural decor. This lot includes 12 individually wrapped stones, each labeled with its type, such as Green Quartz, Rose Quartz, Amethyst, Black Obsidian, Sodalite, Red Jasper, Orchid Calcite, Amazonite, Howlite, Jasper, and two unlabeled but visibly different stones. The variety offers an appealing array of colors and textures, ranging from deep reds and purples to soothing greens and striking blacks. Each stone is presented in its natural, unpolished state, allowing you to appreciate their raw mineral beauty and unique characteristics. These specimens can be displayed, studied, or gifted as a starter pack for any rock or crystal enthusiast. All stones are shown as-is in the images, with visible labels on most pieces and protective wrapping intact. The set appears to be in good used condition, with some exterior paper wrapping showing minor wear. Please review photos for all included items.
